guideText.text: Vari in Aegean Sea is an exposed beach break that has inconsistent surf. Winter is the optimum time of year for surfing here. The best wind direction is from the north northwest with some shelter here from west winds. Able to handle light onshore wind Short period wind swells are the rule and the best wave direction is from the south. Waves at the beach break both left and right. Good surf at all stages of the tide. Sometimes crowded. Vari
